title: BUR to Brickell
body: Flew BUR–DEN–MIA and checked into AC Hotel Brickell — bay, palms, high-rises lighting up. Dinner at Crazy About You on Brickell Bay: tostones, cheese with honey and pistachios, ribs under onion straws, seared fish. The paper liner spelled the name so nobody could miss it.

title: Around Miami & Calle Ocho
body: Waffles, then out — Freedom Tower, One Thousand Museum, the wave sculpture at Ferré Park, El Loro at Bayside, the Octopus Building. Little Havana on foot: guarapo, Domino Park, Old’s Havana mojitos and palomilla, La Colada coffee, a pressed Cuban at Sanguich, then pizza and burrata in Brickell Village like the afternoon needed a second act.

title: Down to Key West
body: Key West Express+ from Key Largo, Overseas Highway glare. Channel 2 Bridge, the old Seven Mile, US 1 over water at Marathon. In town: Garrison Bight, Hard Rock on Duval, Margaritaville, The Wandering Rooster Citroën, The Red Doors from 1827. Back to Brickell that night.

title: On the Lady
body: Bayside in a squall, a Hard Rock burger with a flag in the bun, then Brilliant Lady at PortMiami — eleven nights, Southern Caribbean & Aruban Nights. Late afternoon sail-away.

title: Southbound
body: First full day at sea. Meals that stuck: sushi class at Rice Rice Baby, Rojo Spanish plates, and the Social Club glitter octopuses.

title: Still water
body: Another sea day heading south — Extra Virgin wine tasting and The Test Kitchen Menu A. Aruba in the morning.

title: Around the island
body: Jeep from Oranjestad: Savaneta mangroves, San Nicolas mural, Baby Beach, Fontein Cave, Boca Prins, Arikok dirt, the natural pool, California Lighthouse, Malmok boats, and Passions on the Beach at Eagle Beach — steak wrap, tuna, water doing the color it promised.

title: Toward Colombia
body: Sea day between Aruba and Cartagena. Rojo Night 5 Spanish spread, then Basque cheesecake.

title: City tour
body: Walled city — Castillo San Felipe, the cathedral, a Club Colombia in the heat. Lunch at La Cevicheria. Siphon coffee at Café San Alberto. Pink Agave dinner back on the Lady. Overnight in port.

title: Last light in port
body: Second day in Cartagena, Test Kitchen Menu B at night, afternoon departure.

title: North again
body: At sea toward Jamaica — The Pizza Place egg and pepperoni pies late.

title: River and beach
body: Shore Thing: White River tubing, Bamboo Beach Club, Brilliant Lady on the hook. Pink Agave crudo back aboard.

title: In the water
body: Tender into George Town. Cayman Boat Adventures, mangroves, then in with a stingray on the sand. GoPro did the close pass.

title: Last night on the Lady
body: Sea day back toward Miami — Test Kitchen Menu C, Study of Chicken and Yuzu / Meringue to close the Virgin run.

title: Off the Lady
body: Disembarked Brilliant Lady in Miami at first light. Overnight at Travel Inn Riviera Beach between ships — Hot Pie Pizza and wings in West Palm.

title: On Paradise
body: Boarded Margaritaville at Sea Paradise at Port of Palm Beach — three-night Nassau run. Flip-flops sculpture, cabin, deck kiss.

title: A short hop
body: Sea day on Paradise, Palm Beach toward Nassau.

title: City tour
body: Bay Street: Rum Cake Factory, Queen’s Staircase, a red colonial house flying both flags, tacos at John Watling’s, then the water off West Bay Street — and Julia’s flower wall.

title: West to LAX
body: Off Paradise in Palm Beach. Economy Plus duck faces homeward. Trip’s end — west to LAX.
